content.title: About
content.content: Bread, soy, toasted is a slice of whole‑grain bread that has been toasted to a golden crisp and coated with soy protein. It offers a crunchy texture, a subtle nutty soy aroma, and a high amount of plant‑based protein.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Soy protein is added to boost nutritional value and increase protein content.
Toasting enhances flavor and creates a crunchy bite, ideal for sandwiches and snacks.
Soy‑infused bread is popular in vegetarian and vegan diets as a source of complete protein.
The product can be fortified with B‑vitamins and iron to offset nutrient losses during processing.
Toasted bread retains moisture longer than fresh bread, extending shelf life.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: Soy protein provides all essential amino acids, making the bread a valuable protein source for vegetarians.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: Whole‑grain base and toasting slow carbohydrate absorption, helping maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain bread supplies fiber that supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Contains isoflavones
items.content: Soy isoflavones may help balance hormones and act as antioxidants.

items.title: B‑vitamin complex
items.content: Fortification with vitamins B1, B2, and B6 aids energy metabolism.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: People with soy allergy may experience severe allergic reactions.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Toasted varieties often contain added salt; monitor intake if you watch sodium levels.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Contains wheat, so it is unsuitable for those with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Toasted soy bread works well for sandwiches, snacks, as a base for spreads, avocado toppings, or in recipes that call for a crunchy element.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a dry, cool place in an airtight package. For longer storage, refrigerate to maintain crispness and prevent moisture absorption.
